{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...So you want me to settle that incident. Well, I don't mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I don't know if it'll go well, but I'll try in my own way.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Let's see... I don't think I can make it. Sorry, but could you try someone else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If there's really no one, you can come talk to me again. So, sorry, my dear angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well now... I don't mind. {fb:1E80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...So you want me for that mission. Well, I don't mind. I've no reason to refuse.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Though relying on me too much might be a bit of a problem. I'm not idle either.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1F80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...And you want me for this job? It's not that I couldn't do it, but I'll pass.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}A job like this hardly needs me, does it? I have my own affairs too. Try someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

Being a woman has its advantages at times like this.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sigh... you came all this way for that? Naive as ever.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Someone other than us can handle a job like that. The kingdom has knights, after all.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well... if that's the story, fine. They're all much the same to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Now I just have to pray it's not a nasty one. I'm not invincible either.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I more or less see what it's about, but... I'll pass this time. I'm just... not in the mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Sorry, but ask someone else. If that still doesn't work, I might think about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I more or less see the situation. Fine. As for me, I can hardly refuse, can I?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}That settled, let's head there right away. I hope we make it in time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...I see, but... I'm sorry. Could you leave me be for now?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I have my own circumstances. So try someone else. That's the surest way.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I see... What an unusual case. Well, I doubt it's anything much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}So I just have to settle it. All right. Let's take care of it, more or less.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I wondered what it was about... What an amusing story. Does that really happen?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, I'll pass. If it bothers you that much, have someone else go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What an unusual case. Well, I don't mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}A boring mission... Well, it might make a nice distraction. I'll give it a try, at least.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
